observation.command:
# Kill all dev server serve processes (each is a setsid process group leader)
for pid in 39913 45394 50053; do kill -TERM -- -$pid 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 8
for p in 43189 41487 37315 45423 38489 43781; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
ps aux | grep -E "serve.mjs|run-executor" | grep -v grep | wc -l
free -m | sed -n '2p'
